description: NEW (Nov 2026) — Kie Image Upscale: enlarge ANY image 2x / 4x / 8x (or 1x = same-size enhance: denoise + sharpen) keeping the aspect ratio. Detail is restored generatively; text regions get a fidelity pass so lettering is not rewritten. Billed by OUTPUT pixels: 1.5 cr up to 4.19 MP (~2048²), 4 cr up to 16.78 MP (~4096²), 12 cr up to 67.11 MP (~8192²). Input: public URL, JPG/PNG/WEBP/GIF (first frame), ≤20 MB. Output must stay ≤67 MP and ≤16,384 px per side — kie rejects larger requests at submit with a 422 (no charge), so lower upscale_factor. Upload local files with upload_file first.

download_dir.description: Absolute directory to save into (created if missing). Defaults to the server's kie/assets/raw/.

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

image_url.description: Public URL of the source image

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

max_wait_seconds.description: Override the blocking-mode polling budget in seconds. Ignored when wait=false.

upscale_factor.description: Multiplies width AND height. 1 = enhance at the same size

wait.description: Set false to submit and return immediately with the task_id (async mode) — then poll with check_task and fetch with download_result.

name: upscale_image
